description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeMembershipDao component of the OrangeHRM project. It contains test methods to verify CRUD operations and search functionalities related to EmployeeMembership entities within the PIM plugin module.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case for testing EmployeeMembershipDao functionalities like get, save, delete, and search EmployeeMembership records in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmployeeMembershipDao, and populates test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving an EmployeeMembership by ID returns correct subscription details.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Checks that deleting multiple employee memberships returns the expected count.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests search functionality for employee memberships filtering by employee number.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeMembershipWithLimit
methods.description: Tests search with a limit parameter to ensure only the specified number of results are returned.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Verifies saving a new EmployeeMembership entity stores the correct data and returns the saved object.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Checks updating an existing EmployeeMembership and verifies the changes are persisted correctly.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Ensures the count of employee memberships matching search criteria is accurate.
